calibration.use: feature thresholds and RAW closing-MFE Q40 only

opened_development.use: INVALIDATED_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_EVIDENCE; final remediation run must not decode this interval

source_signal.mid: arithmetic midpoint of BID and ASK OHLC
source_signal.direction: LONG when EMA3>EMA12, SHORT when EMA3<EMA12, equality emits no proposal
source_signal.density: one RAW proposal on every completed contiguous M5 bar after warm-up; no session, spread, fee, slippage, expectancy, or cost gate
source_signal.entry: first exact source M5 open with timestamp strictly greater than the completed-bar decision timestamp

calibration.threshold_scope: pair and side for MFE; pair for path efficiency; pair x UTC minute-of-day for spread
calibration.usd_breadth: mean USD-node one-bar direction across available exact-time symbols; at least two symbols required

P4.name: CALIBRATION_RAW_CLOSE_MFE_Q40_TP_MAX48
P4.tp: same frozen pair-side Q40 as P3

P5.name: FX_LGAR
P5.trapped: path-efficiency-high and at least two of momentum, prior-rail, USD-breadth oppose the lot; unwind at next strictly-later exact open
P5.neutral: at age 24, any non-HARVEST lot unwinds at next strictly-later exact open
P5.harvest: positive RAW close mark, calibration-slot spread good, non-TRAPPED, and aligned momentum or rail with non-opposing USD breadth

P6.name: FX_LGAR_PLUS_50PCT_CLOSE_MFE_GIVEBACK
P6.profit_lock: after frozen Q40 TP is reached by RAW close mark, unwind after RAW close mark gives back at least 50% of peak closing MFE

P7.name: FX_LGAR_PROFIT_LOCK_PLUS_USD_NODE_BASKET
P7.basket: when a same-signed USD-node group contains STALE or TRAPPED inventory and its exact-time aggregate RAW marked PnL in JPY is non-negative, unwind the group at each pair's next strictly-later exact open

execution_arms.RAW_SIGNAL: mid open to identical policy exit; no spread, fee, or slippage
execution_arms.EXECUTABLE_BASE: same signal and policy action timestamps; observed BID/ASK plus 0.3 pip slippage per side
execution_arms.ADVERSE_STRESS: same signal and policy action timestamps; observed BID/ASK plus 0.9 pip slippage per side

portfolio.shared_hard_execution_equity_ledger: EXECUTABLE_BASE marked equity; applies identically to all arms after RAW proposal logging
portfolio.adverse_stress_margin_rule: record first marked margin-closeout or ruin outcome without rejecting entries or changing shared policy lineage
portfolio.financing_model: zero over the maximum four-hour vehicle; limitation disclosed

gap_policy.open_inventory_at_gap: last observed executable close is recorded as DATA_GAP_TERMINAL_MTM and separately counted

selection.cluster: UTC decision day across all symbols
selection.winner: highest tuning RAW mean pips per trade; evidence admission additionally requires corrected LCB>0
